# Meridian Marine Co. — Vendor Performance Standard v1

## Purpose

Measure third-party performance consistently so MMC can protect client outcomes and maintain a dependable preferred network.

## Performance dimensions

Evaluate vendors on:

- Reliability
- Response time
- Communication
- Schedule adherence
- Work quality
- Professional conduct
- Pricing/invoice accuracy
- Client/vessel care
- Documentation

## Performance levels

### Preferred
Consistently reliable and suitable for recurring recommendations.

### Qualified
Meets MMC baseline requirements but has limited performance history or mixed evidence.

### Watch
Performance issue identified; continued use requires attention or management review.

### Restricted
Use only with explicit management approval or defined conditions.

### Inactive
No longer recommended for new assignments.

## Review triggers

Review vendor performance after:

- Material service failure
- Safety incident
- Repeated lateness
- Poor communication
- Significant invoice discrepancy
- Client complaint
- Repeated quality issue

## Vendor score principle

Do not select vendors solely on lowest price. Reliability, workmanship, communication, and protection of the owner's vessel are core factors.
